note: R7-C: per case, rays from each aim's centre (the global bounding rect of an item's graphic element, a series view's polyline / polygon, a graph edge or an item's label, rounded; or a point) in eight directions, a pixel a step, out to the half diagonal and 4 (or the point's reach) or the canvas' edge: `seq` what findHover(x, y).target is at each step, run-length encoded -- sS/D the series and data index of the ECData the dispatcher walk finds (sS/eD an edge), sS/- a series' ECData without a data index, x a target without one, - none. `tol`: the steps a run's ends may lie off these where the port holds a curve as points.
